source_of_truth: Read by hand in a Nuxt 4 app with an explicit .frontend-audit.json. app/shared/money/format.ts is a pure, domain-free currency formatter classified as shared. Four business domains (pricing, billing, shipping, tax) each import it via `~/shared/money/format`. A superficial 'a file used by 4 domains is a hotspot' reading would flag it, but (a) the file is shared-kind, not a business domain, so it is correct for many domains to depend on it, and (b) it imports nothing from any domain, so shared-imports-domain does not apply. No boundary is broken; this is a correctly placed shared utility.
provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from source without consulting tool output

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the file is shared-kind (app/shared/**), the exact home for code many domains use; a shared utility used widely is its purpose, not a coupling defect.
the helper imports nothing from any business domain (only the Intl built-in); shared-imports-domain fires when shared code depends on a domain, which never happens here.
